name: hardware-product-from-prompt
description: Design a complete hardware product from a plain-language ask on an open toolchain: requirements, architecture exploration scored against a conventional baseline, datasheet-verified schematic as code, worst-case review of protection, isolation and emergency stops, optimized layout with zero-violation DRC, fab package, firmware, enclosure, wire harness, measured bring-up, system acceptance, and a predicted-versus-measured report of every gain over baseline.
